name: net.fosa.avatar-texture-optimizer
description:
ATO (AvatarTextureOptimizer): an open-source NDMF tool for VRChat avatars. It analyzes avatar meshes, builds UV-to-texture mappings, shrinks UV islands to target quality, re-packs islands into one or more atlases, and applies safe import-settings optimization — to maximize texture utilization while preserving appearance.

ATO（AvatarTextureOptimizer）：开源的 VRChat Avatar NDMF 工具。分析 Avatar 网格，建立网格 UV 到贴图的映射，按目标质量算法缩小 UV 岛，将 UV 岛重新打包进一个或多个图集，并做安全的导入参数优化——在保证观感一致的前提下最大化贴图利用率。
